checks: Regular API startup selects Jena and bootstraps namespaces
Health reports Jena without contacting GraphDB
Private identity verification requires its service credential
Refresh cookie reloads user permissions through Jena
Existing credential login issues a token accepted by the Jena service
Real Redis metadata cache is populated and hit during repeated search/detail reads
Warm shared cache does not transfer reader access to another identity
Warm read access does not authorize a write
Warm detail and search projection see committed value updates immediately
Object permission downgrade immediately removes warm detail/search/count results
Restored object permission immediately restores warm reads
Orphaned grant cannot retain access through a warm cache
Previously issued token immediately observes role removal with warm cache
Fresh login after role removal cannot read previously cached resources
Fresh login after role restoration sees the current authorized result
Account deactivation blocks new login and refresh despite warm cache
Existing access token retains the documented bounded lifetime after deactivation

cache.scope: Owned synthetic Jena/Redis; sequential API requests; no production cache or concurrent load.
